findings.summary: The Done-when command `pnpm test -- tests/unit/cnpj.test.ts tests/unit/money.test.ts` does not filter: pnpm forwards a literal `--` to `vitest run`, which ran all 4 test files / 146 tests (including sibling units' questionBank and forbiddenTerms tests). It exits 0 now, so the unit's Done-when is met, but the command is not scoped to this unit and will fail if a sibling test fails. Scoped equivalent: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/cnpj.test.ts tests/unit/money.test.ts` (2 files, 128 tests, exit 0).

evidence.result: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 146 passed (146). The `--` form ran the whole suite.

The band thresholds (<1, 1-3, 3-5 inclusive, >5), the one-decimal ratio, payback rounded up and 'não se paga' match RULE-dm-03, BR-dm-03, BR-dm-15 and AC-dm-51. The implementer's message signatures match the code: maskCnpjInput, maskMoneyInput (cents null when empty), formatRatio, getRatioBand, formatRatioWithBand, formatPayback, the *_KEYS tuples, *_LABELS, *_OPTIONS and get*Label.

messages.text: Scope the Done-when check to this unit with `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/cnpj.test.ts tests/unit/money.test.ts` or `pnpm test tests/unit/cnpj.test.ts tests/unit/money.test.ts` (no `--`). The `--` form in the plan runs the full suite under pnpm 11 / vitest 5.0.5. Keep the full-suite form only if a full run is acceptable.

Deferred checks not owned by this unit (not run by QA here). Run after the frontend and e2e units land, with the app started by `pnpm dev`: (a) `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` for AC-dm-08 (aria-invalid and inline message on blur, inputmode numeric, maxlength 18, mask while typing) and AC-dm-17; (b) `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts` for AC-dm-15 and AC-dm-51 on the real screen; (c) `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/unitEconomics.test.ts` for formulas, rounding, BR-dm-14 and BR-dm-15 once shared/domain/unitEconomics.ts exists. These were not run by QA because the files are owned by other units.

Product decision needed before release: the PRD fixes the CNPJ as 14 numeric digits (AC-dm-08, IF-002). The implementer reports that the Receita Federal may issue alphanumeric CNPJs from July 2026. That claim is not verified here. isValidCnpj rejects any non-digit, so such a company would be refused. No change was made because the PRD says numeric.

Confirmed against the code: maskCnpjInput(rawValue, caret?, previous?) returns { value, caret }; maskMoneyInput(rawValue, caret?, previous?) returns { value, caret, cents } with cents null when empty. Pass e.target.value, e.target.selectionStart and the value held before the keystroke, then restore the caret in a layout effect. Backspace over a separator relies on `previous`.

Confirmed against the code: formatRatio(ratio) gives 'x,y×' with one decimal half up, and 'não calculado' for null, NaN, Infinity or negative. getRatioBand(ratio) judges the exact ratio: <1 critical, 1 to <3 attention, 3 to 5 inclusive healthy, >5 invest_more, null when unknown. formatRatioWithBand gives '0,0× Crítico' for 0. formatPayback(months | 'never' | null) rounds up and gives 'não se paga' for 'never' or Infinity.

Confirmed: SEGMENT_KEYS, SALES_CHANNEL_KEYS and ANNUAL_REVENUE_RANGE_KEYS are as const tuples ready for z.enum. The *_LABELS records, *_OPTIONS arrays of { key, label } and get*Label(key) helpers return the key itself for unknown values. Store the CNPJ as 14 digits, validated with isValidCnpj.
